g.text: How accurate is ServeScope’s GPU timing model?
Grouped five-fold outer CV · function/scale selection inside three inner folds · all imported compatible dense profiles
N = 599,451 | Mean absolute error 14.86% | Median 9.54% | P95 49.52% | Within ±20%: 74.8%
Every eligible observation is plotted. Relative error = (prediction − profile) / profile. GPU timing only; serving throughput and energy require separate validation.
